question.text:
0.53 g of an organic compound (x) when heated with excess of nitric acid (concentrated) and then with silver nitrate gave 0.75 g of silver bromide precipitate. 1.0 g of $(\mathrm{x})$ gave 1.32 g of $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ gas on combustion. The percentage of hydrogen in the compound $(\mathrm{x})$ is $\_\_\_\_$%.
[Nearest Integer]
[Given: Molar mass in $\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \mathrm{H}: 1, \mathrm{C}: 12, \mathrm{Br}: 80, \mathrm{Ag}: 108, \mathrm{O}: 16$; Compound (x) : $\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{H}_{\mathrm{y}} \mathrm{Br}_{\mathrm{z}}$]
